title: Life and Ruins in the Clouds

pages.text: Cloud jellies drift on sacs of light gas and sieve sulfur from the air. Acid rays glide in wide curves; leave them alone, or they spray acid that eats into armour.
A derelict aerostat floats above the cloud tops. Its lab and stores still hold tech disks, guarded by acid rays.
Put any armour piece and a fluoropolymer coating together in a crafting grid to make it acid-proof.
Light composite panels and aerogel build platforms that float in the breathable-air layer.
